summary: Input size="sm" is text-sm (14px) at every width and density="compact" (line 103) is 0.8125rem with no mobile override, so iOS Safari zooms the page on focus. Affected: handle-search Combobox (groups/handle-search.tsx:211, org member add + ownership transfer), group handle field (groups/group-account-manager.tsx:174), and the compact meta fields in create/page.tsx:674/685/724 and feed/activity-detail.tsx. Textarea sm (textarea.tsx:62, compact :76) and Select sm (select.tsx:18) have the same problem.
fix: Copy the md pattern into sm and compact: `sm: "h-9 px-3 text-base md:text-sm"`, and compactClasses `text-base md:text-[0.8125rem]`. Do the same in textarea.tsx and select.tsx. Below 800px the text is 16px; at 800px and up it stays as now.

summary: These hand-styled inputs are below 16px and have no max-width:799px override, so iOS zooms on focus: .funding-form__input 0.875rem (every field in the funding receipt / confirm modals, amount included), .profile-groups__search-input 0.875rem (profile-groups.css:80), .link-dialog__input 0.9375rem (leaflet.css:421, link and embed dialogs), .onboarding-step__picker-search input 0.875rem (components.css:1964), .delete-record-dialog__input 0.9375rem (components.css:79).
fix: Add the 16px override that components.css:1304, feed.css:1646 and cert-detail.css:2367 already use: `@media (max-width: 799px) { .funding-form__input, .profile-groups__search-input, .link-dialog__input, .onboarding-step__picker-search input, .delete-record-dialog__input { font-size: 16px; } }`. Better still, move these fields onto <Input>/<Textarea> once R01 is fixed.

summary: No hover style is gated by capability. The only (hover: hover) check is in tooltip.tsx JS. There are about 300 :hover rules in src/app/styles and about 56 Tailwind hover: utilities, including the Button primitive (button.tsx:56-60: hover:opacity-90, hover:bg-overlay). After a tap on iOS or Android, the hover style stays on the element until the next tap elsewhere (dimmed primary buttons, underlined titles, shaded rows).
fix: Add `future: { hoverOnlyWhenSupported: true }` to tailwind.config.ts (Tailwind 3.4), which wraps every hover: utility in @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine). For the CSS files, wrap the :hover blocks in `@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { ... }`, starting with feed.css, layout.css, explore.css, components.css and profile-endorsements.css, and give important tap targets an :active state so they still respond to touch.

summary: Hover is undone on touch by screen width, not by input type: `@media (max-width: 799px) { .funding-receipt-row:hover { background: var(--bg-elevated) } }`. Touch devices 800px or wider (iPad, a large phone in landscape at ~930px) keep the sticky hover. The comment says 'No hover wash on touch', but width does not detect touch.
fix: Remove the width-based reset and put the hover rule under `@media (hover: hover)` (see R03). Keep the :active press state as it is.

summary: viewport.themeColor is chosen by the OS prefers-color-scheme, but the theme actually shown comes from next-themes, with defaultTheme="light" (lib/providers.tsx:9) and a manual toggle. A user with a dark OS on the default light theme gets a #0b0b0d browser toolbar / status bar above a #f9f9f6 page, and the opposite when choosing dark on a light OS. The PWA status bar is mismatched the same way.
fix: Set the meta from the resolved theme: a small client effect on next-themes resolvedTheme that sets `document.querySelector('meta[name=theme-color]').content` to the computed value of --bg-canvas (read with getComputedStyle, so no hex is duplicated outside tokens.css). Keep the static media entries for first paint.

summary: Overlay height caps use vh, which on iOS means the large viewport (toolbars hidden). When the Safari toolbar is visible, the bottom of a tall dialog (where the action buttons are) sits under it. Affected: AppDialog `max-h-[calc(100vh-40px)]` (used by every modal), BottomSheet `max-h-[70vh]` / expanded `92vh` (bottom-sheet.tsx:93-95, mirrored in pages.css:705), .domain-modal `max-height: 100vh` on mobile (components.css:1043), feedback modal `calc(100vh - 40px)` (components.css:142).
fix: Switch to dynamic viewport units: `max-h-[calc(100dvh-40px)]`, `max-[799px]:max-h-[70dvh]` / `[92dvh]`, `max-height: 100dvh`. Optionally keep a vh line first as a fallback for old browsers.

summary: <body> uses Tailwind min-h-screen (100vh). On iOS with toolbars visible, short pages are taller than the screen, so they scroll and rubber-band, and the sticky footer starts just below the fold. .app-page also adds another min-height: 100vh inside the shell (layout.css:630; used by help/imprint/privacy/terms/dsa), which makes those pages at least 100vh plus the navbar and padding.
fix: Use `min-h-svh` (Tailwind 3.4) or `min-h-dvh` on body. Delete the `min-height: 100vh` on .app-page, since the .app-shell flex chain already fills the viewport (see the comment at layout.css:648).

summary: viewportFit: "cover" is enabled (layout.tsx:83), but nothing uses env(safe-area-inset-left/right/top). In landscape on a notched iPhone, the fixed .navbar (layout.css:140), .bottom-nav (:413), the fixed acting-as bar (:1004), the left Drawer (drawer.tsx:104) and the page gutters run under the notch and the rounded corners.
fix: Add `padding-left: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-left)); padding-right: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-right));` to the navbar, bottom-nav, acting-as bar and .app-shell__content mobile gutter, and `padding-left: env(safe-area-inset-left)` to the left drawer panel. If notch support isn't wanted, remove viewportFit: cover.

summary: `pb-[env(safe-area-inset-bottom,16px)]` only uses the 16px fallback when env() is unsupported. On Android and home-button iPhones the inset is 0px, so the last row of every bottom sheet sits flush against the screen edge. pages.css:729 has the same problem.
fix: Use `pb-[max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))]` and `padding-bottom: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom));`.

summary: No overscroll-behavior anywhere in src. Scroll inside the Drawer panel (overflow-y-auto), the BottomSheet body (bottom-sheet.tsx:143), AppDialog (overflow-y-auto), the account-switcher list (desktop-top-bar.tsx:533) and combobox dropdowns chains into the page or triggers Chrome Android pull-to-refresh when it reaches the end. The horizontal .profile-tabs strip (profile.css:241) can start a browser back-swipe.
fix: Add `overscroll-contain` (Tailwind) / `overscroll-behavior: contain` to the drawer panel, the bottom-sheet scroll body, the AppDialog element and the listbox; add `overscroll-behavior-x: contain` to .profile-tabs.

summary: -webkit-tap-highlight-color is set only on .bottom-nav__item (layout.css:454). Every other link and button, including whole-card links like .feed-card__body and the funding rows, shows the gray/blue WebKit flash on tap.
fix: Set `-webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;` on html in tokens.css (it is a keyword, not a raw color). Check that main tap targets have :active / press-scale feedback so the flash isn't the only response.

summary: The mobile profile H1 (.profile-hero__name, 1.5rem serif) has no overflow-wrap. When there is no displayName, ProfileHeader shows `@${handle}` (profile-header.tsx:75), e.g. `@bartholomew-fitzgerald.certified.example.com`, which has no break points and pushes the page wider than a 375px screen. .profile-hero__handle (:96) is a flex row with no min-width:0 or overflow-wrap, so a long handle next to the 'Bluesky profile' tag overflows as well.
fix: Add `overflow-wrap: anywhere;` to .profile-hero__name. On .profile-hero__handle, wrap the handle text in a span with `min-width: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere;` (or ellipsis) and set `flex-shrink: 0` on the tag.

summary: .mobile-sidebar__name and .mobile-sidebar__handle (:577) have no truncation or wrapping. Their parent .mobile-sidebar__profile has min-width:0, but a long display name or a domain handle overflows the drawer (max-width 320px) and makes it scroll sideways.
fix: Add `overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap;` to both rules, or `overflow-wrap: anywhere` if the full handle should show.

summary: Initials are taken by UTF-16 code unit: `parts[0][0]` produces a lone surrogate (shown as a replacement glyph) for names starting with an emoji, such as '🦊 Fox' or '👩🏽‍💻 Priya', and `slice(0, 2)` cuts ZWJ and flag sequences apart. The same naive slicing appears in avatar.tsx:112, step-profile.tsx:102 (slice(0,1)), handle-search.tsx:268, mobile-sidebar.tsx:57, navbar.tsx:121 and slack-columns-layout.tsx:43 (charAt(0)).
fix: Split by grapheme: add `firstGraphemes(s, n)` to lib/utils/graphemes.ts using Intl.Segmenter (fallback Array.from), use it in getInitials, and route the ad-hoc call sites through getInitials. In Avatar, drop the extra `.slice(0, 2)` or make it grapheme-aware.

summary: Funding amounts are shown as the raw record string (`{receipt.amount}`, which accepts up to 50 characters, funding-receipt-form-modal.tsx:254) with no digit grouping, so 12345678.9 USDC appears as '12345678.9'. The same applies to funding-receipt-detail-modal.tsx:272 and confirm-funding-dialog.tsx:115. On desktop the amount column is a fixed 7rem with nowrap and ellipsis (explore.css:1217, :1264), so large amounts are cut to e.g. '1234567…'. Cutting off a number is wrong data, not just a layout issue.
fix: Add formatAmount(str) that groups the integer part as a string (no float conversion; e.g. Intl.NumberFormat on BigInt for the integer part plus the original decimals). Use it in all three places with tabular-nums. Make the desktop amount track `minmax(7rem, max-content)` and remove the ellipsis from .funding-receipt-row__amount.

summary: Line-clamped text blocks (-webkit-box plus overflow:hidden) have no overflow-wrap. A pasted URL or long German compound in a description runs past the right edge and is clipped mid-character with no ellipsis, since the clamp only adds ellipses at line ends. Affected: .feed-card__desc, .explore-project-card__title/__desc (explore.css:1664/1678), .explore-user-card__desc (explore.css:1084), .profile-groups__description (profile-groups.css:359), .home-feed__sentence (home.css:498).
fix: Add `overflow-wrap: anywhere;` to each clamped rule so long tokens break inside the clamp and the ellipsis lands on the last line.

summary: There is no global wrapping default. Only about 35 rules set overflow-wrap or word-break, so any new text node holding user data (titles, notes, list names, contributor names) overflows on unbreakable input unless someone remembers to add a rule. R12, R13, R16, R18 and R19 all come from this.
fix: Add `overflow-wrap: break-word;` to body in tokens.css. It inherits and only breaks a word when it can't fit, so normal text is unchanged. Keep per-component `anywhere` where min-content sizing matters (flex/grid items).

summary: .activity-detail__contributor-name has only font-weight. Contributors can be free-text identities or contributorInformation records (an email address, a URL, a long org name). Inside the flex .activity-detail__contributor-link they overflow the contributors list on mobile. The handle line (:654) already uses break-all, but the name doesn't.
fix: Add `overflow-wrap: anywhere;` (or `min-width:0; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap;` to match the other bylines).

summary: .endorsement-lists__row-title (user-written list title) and .profile-overview__activity-title (layout.css:3034, activity title in the overview list) have no wrap or truncation rule. Their parents have min-width:0, but an unbreakable title still spills out of the row and card border.
fix: Add `overflow-wrap: anywhere;` (or a 2-line clamp with overflow-wrap) to both.

summary: No element in src sets dir="auto". User-written text (display names, titles, descriptions, endorsement notes) inherits LTR, so an Arabic or Hebrew name like 'نور الهدى' gets its trailing punctuation and digits on the wrong side, and mixed lines such as the acting-as bar ('Operating <RTL org> as @handle') or 'Endorsed by' rows reorder.
fix: Put dir="auto" on the elements that render user strings: name/handle spans in activity-author, identity-row, endorsement-subject-row, profile-header h1 (profile-header.tsx:162), feed-card title/desc (activity-card.tsx:73-76), cert-detail title/description, group/project titles. Use <bdi> for names embedded in sentences (acting-as-bar.tsx:43, home-feed sentences).

summary: The labels 'followers' and 'following' are fixed text after the count, so the page shows '1 followers' (profile-header.tsx:204 and the desktop profile-sidebar.tsx:350). 'Endorsed by 1' reads fine.
fix: `{count === 1 ? "follower" : "followers"}`, using the raw count rather than the formatted string. Or use Intl.PluralRules in a small plural() helper.

summary: activityCountLabel is `${activityCount}` without grouping, so 12,345 activities appear as '12345 activity claims', while the follower counts next to it use Intl.NumberFormat (formatGraphCount). The tab-badge formatCount helpers also print raw numbers: profile-followers.tsx:287 (followers can reach 10,000+), profile-endorsements.tsx:629, profile-certs.tsx:236.
fix: Format with Intl.NumberFormat everywhere (reuse formatGraphCount, or use a compact format for badges, e.g. `notation: "compact"` gives '10K').

summary: The contributor tile's hover overlay (hoverImageUrl / hoverIframeUrl) appears only on `.contributor-tile:hover`. Touch users can't reach it, or it sticks after a tap, and keyboard users never see it because there is no :focus-visible / :focus-within rule. The fancy board's sheen, glow and weight reveal (fancy-contributor-board.css:159-273) work the same way.
fix: Add `.contributor-tile:focus-visible .contributor-tile__hover, .contributor-tile:focus-within .contributor-tile__hover { opacity: 1 }`, gate the hover rule with @media (hover: hover), and decide on a tap behavior for touch (e.g. first tap shows the overlay).

summary:
The feed card renders `

{value.title}

` with no fallback. A whitespace or empty title from a third-party record produces a zero-height heading, and the card shows the image straight above the description. profile-overview.tsx:432 already uses 'Untitled activity'.
fix: `{value.title?.trim() || "Untitled activity"}`, ideally from one shared helper so every surface uses the same fallback.

summary: The desktop profile H1 (.profile-sidebar__name) is nowrap with an ellipsis and has no title attribute, so a 64-character display name is cut off on the one page that exists to show it. On desktop, .project-detail__title (project-detail.css:234) also truncates the H1 to one line (it does have a title attribute) even though titles can be up to 80 graphemes.
fix: Let detail-page H1s wrap: `white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: anywhere;`, with an optional 2-3 line clamp. Keep ellipsis for list rows and bylines only.

summary: The mobile profile tab strip (.profile-tabs) scrolls sideways with a hidden scrollbar, no edge fade and no snap. When a deep link selects an off-screen tab (e.g. the header's 'Endorsed by' link to ?tab=endorsements), the active tab stays out of view.
fix: On tab change, call `activeTabEl.scrollIntoView({ inline: "nearest", block: "nearest" })`. Add `scroll-snap-type: x proximity` plus a mask-image edge fade so users can see there are more tabs.

summary: Bottom-nav items and other icon+label controls have no `user-select: none` or `-webkit-touch-callout: none`. Long-pressing a bottom-nav tab selects its label or opens the iOS link-preview callout, which feels like a web page rather than an app.
fix: Add `user-select: none; -webkit-touch-callout: none;` to .bottom-nav__item, and the same to the Button primitive's base class. Leave content links alone.
